usage: Use 綠 to describe something that is green in colour, especially plants, leaves, grass, and other natural things.
As a noun, 綠 can mean the colour green itself, as in colour names and design contexts.
It is a very common everyday word and sounds neutral and natural in both spoken Cantonese and writing.
For beginners, remember that 綠 is often used in simple descriptions of plants and scenery, and it can also appear in fixed colour terms.
